changelog: New: a scored, multi-anchor /SmartSimilar/Score endpoint. It takes several seed titles at once and returns the numbers instead of only an order - the mean score, the breakdown per seed, and the genres, tags, people and studios behind each match. TMDb is honoured too: its rank is mapped onto the same scale, and Hybrid keeps the local score while lifting what TMDb also names. The existing More Like This row is unchanged.
description: Replaces the native "More Like This" section with better similarity results from a selectable provider, excluding items of the same collection.
name: Smart Similar
